text:
### Screening Requirements  
**Mandatory Screening Against:**
- OFAC Sanctions List
- EU Consolidated Sanctions List
- HMT Sanctions List
- UN Sanctions List
- PEP Database  
**Additional Screening (High-Risk):**
- Adverse media screening
- Beneficial ownership (if entity)
name: Chunk 17/37

raw_entities.name: OFAC Sanctions List Screening
aliases: Office of Foreign Assets Control screening
raw_entities.description: Mandatory screening requirement against the OFAC Sanctions List as part of the bank's anti-money laundering compliance obligations. This is a first-line sanctions check applied to all customers and transactions.
context: Mandatory Screening Against: OFAC Sanctions List

raw_entities.name: EU Consolidated Sanctions List Screening
raw_entities.description: Mandatory screening requirement against the EU Consolidated Sanctions List as part of the bank's anti-money laundering compliance obligations. This check applies to all customers and transactions subject to EU regulatory jurisdiction.
context: Mandatory Screening Against: EU Consolidated Sanctions List

raw_entities.name: HMT Sanctions List Screening
raw_entities.description: Mandatory screening requirement against the HMT Sanctions List as part of the bank's anti-money laundering compliance obligations. This is a UK-specific sanctions check required for all customers and transactions.
context: Mandatory Screening Against: HMT Sanctions List

raw_entities.name: UN Sanctions List Screening
raw_entities.description: Mandatory screening requirement against the UN Sanctions List as part of the bank's anti-money laundering compliance obligations. This check applies to all customers and transactions to ensure compliance with international sanctions regimes.
context: Mandatory Screening Against: UN Sanctions List

raw_entities.name: PEP Database Screening
raw_entities.description: Mandatory screening requirement against the PEP Database to identify politically exposed persons as part of the bank's anti-money laundering compliance obligations. This check applies to all customers to mitigate reputational and financial crime risks.

raw_entities.name: Adverse Media Screening
raw_entities.description: Additional screening requirement applied to high-risk customers to identify negative news, reputational concerns, or adverse information about the customer or their beneficial owners. This enhanced check supplements mandatory sanctions and PEP screening.

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Screening
raw_entities.description: Additional screening requirement applied to high-risk entity customers to identify and verify beneficial owners. This enhanced due diligence check is conditional on the customer being classified as an entity rather than an individual.
